Bump repository/runtime version to 0.1.4 per project versioning rule.
CI green -> expected-head merge -> main CI -> exact-SHA deploy -> version-attested production health.

resumeRule: Preserve v0.1.1 Worker-secret hardening, v0.1.2 human exam entry, and v0.1.3 share/rank comparison behavior. Do not treat HTTP 200 alone as production success.
